data.name: Six Sides of the World
data.detailed_description:
SIX SIDES OF THE WORLD – ALL HAIL THE PUZZLE LORD!

“Six Sides of the World” is a puzzle videogame that takes you into an intergalactic journey through different star systems riddled with brain-racking challenges.

THE ULTIMATE MATCH: YOUR BRAINS vs SCI-FI HAZARDS

Spatial orientation, logic and pure wit will be your weapons to go through the different cube shaped planetary systems. Each level will bring the threats to a whole new level, adding all kinds of sci-fi hazards: from portals to laser beams.
You will need to carefully analyze each cubic planet to understand its dangers and potential solutions. Rushing might lead you to death: it’s all about breaking down each puzzle and finding the right pace.

EXPLORE A VAST GALAXY SYSTEM

Six Sides of the World presents you a series of star systems to be explored. Each one is comprised by different puzzles that introduce new and more challenging mechanics. But most interesting feature of this is that these star systems can be navigated linearly, following a easier predetermined path; or you can make a detour if you are brave enough. Some of the puzzles will present more than one possible solution, enabling the player to achieve a more difficult victory, that will unlock new extra puzzles.

FROM TEST OF WIT TO ULTIMATE HEADACHE!

The freedom of exploration in Six Sides of the World let you set the difficulty: the linear path takes an intelligent and resolutive mind; but the additional solutions to some of the puzzles require a true sense of understanding of each puzzle. And that’s not all! These solutions will lead you to extra puzzles that are capable of driving you insane. It is a smart way of letting the player to set the difficulty by him/herself: going for the extra solution is a way of asking for bigger challenges. And the extra levels are the biggest challenges you can face! There is a difference between understanding new mechanics and getting to their true core. Are you ready?

ALL HAIL THE PUZZLE LORD!

Maigo is an explorer who’s about to discover something far bigger than he expects. As he navigates through space, facing increasingly difficult puzzles, he starts to understand he’s tapping over something transcendent. Some questions arise: who has created all these worlds? What motivates this intergalactic architect? There’s an utter plan beyond all this? It is a test? A mean to protect something? In seek of the truth Maigo will have to overcome all the challenges to meet this kind of… PUZZLE GOD.

FEATURES

  • A galaxy of puzzles: Dozens of creative, defying and engaging puzzles set in cubic planetary systems
  • Choose your way to victory: Non-linear progression with different difficulty levels. Follow the easy levels to end the game, explore the optional ones to face a real challenge.
  • Easy to control, hard to master:Easy and intuitive controls, playable with the mouse and only one button.
  • Otherworldly music: Soundtrack composed by Carlos Viola.

reviews.review:
Six Sides of the World is a thoughtful indie puzzle experience developed and published by Cybernetik Design that proves compelling ideas do not require extravagant production values. Built around the concept of traversing cube-shaped planets, the game immediately distinguishes itself from countless other puzzle titles on Steam. Players assume the role of Maigo, a lone explorer traveling across a distant galaxy in search of answers hidden within strange worlds crafted by an enigmatic cosmic entity. The premise may sound simple at first glance, but the game's unique approach to level design gives it an identity that remains memorable long after its final puzzles have been solved.

The heart of the experience lies in navigating six-sided planets where every surface connects seamlessly to another. Each level introduces environmental mechanics such as switches, teleporters, moving platforms, lasers, and traps that must be understood and manipulated to progress. What makes the game particularly engaging is how it constantly challenges players to rethink their perspective. A path that appears inaccessible on one face of a cube may reveal itself as obvious once another side is explored. This constant shift in spatial awareness creates a satisfying sense of discovery and encourages experimentation rather than brute-force solutions.

Cybernetik Design does an admirable job of gradually increasing the difficulty. Early stages act as tutorials without feeling overly restrictive, allowing players to become familiar with the game's logic before introducing more elaborate combinations of mechanics. By the midpoint, puzzles become considerably more intricate, demanding patience, planning, and a willingness to revisit previous assumptions. The game also accommodates different playstyles through its non-linear progression structure. Those interested in simply reaching the conclusion can take more forgiving routes, while completionists will find optional challenges that significantly increase the level of complexity.

Visually, Six Sides of the World embraces a minimalist art style that complements its design philosophy. The cube planets float in vast stretches of space, creating an atmosphere that feels both peaceful and mysterious. While the presentation lacks the technical sophistication of larger productions, it succeeds by maintaining clarity and consistency. Every object serves a purpose, ensuring players are never confused about what elements are interactive. The soundtrack, composed by Carlos Viola, further enhances the experience with ambient tracks that reinforce the feeling of venturing through an unfamiliar corner of the universe. The music is subtle but effective, helping establish a contemplative mood throughout the adventure.

The game's narrative remains intentionally understated. Rather than delivering lengthy dialogue sequences or cinematic moments, it relies on environmental context and the player's curiosity to maintain momentum. Questions surrounding Maigo's journey and the origins of these peculiar worlds provide enough intrigue to keep players invested without distracting from the puzzle-solving focus. Additional features such as Steam achievements, trading cards, cloud saves, and controller support round out the package and demonstrate a level of polish that puzzle enthusiasts will appreciate.

Despite its strengths, Six Sides of the World is not entirely without shortcomings. Some of the later puzzles can become excessively demanding, occasionally crossing the line from challenging to tedious, particularly when players must retrace their steps after an incorrect decision. The sparse storytelling may also leave those seeking a more narrative-driven experience feeling unsatisfied. Nevertheless, these issues do little to overshadow the creativity at the center of the game. It remains an intelligently designed title that rewards observation, persistence, and logical thinking.

Ultimately, Six Sides of the World succeeds by committing wholeheartedly to its central concept. It transforms a collection of interconnected cubes into a fascinating puzzle playground that consistently encourages players to think differently. While its niche appeal means it may not resonate with every audience, fans of cerebral adventures and spatial puzzles will find plenty to admire. Years after its release, it remains a noteworthy example of how inventive mechanics and strong level design can elevate an independent game beyond its modest scope.

Rating: 8/10
